MODULE 01 · DYNAMIC

动态图表写作全套句式

适用：折线图、动态柱状图（数据随时间变化）。从开篇到结尾，每一句都有模板 + 真题变体。

一、动态图表写作全套句式

适用：折线图、动态柱状图（数据随时间变化）

1. 图表开篇总起句

通用基础模板句

①As is vividly illustrated in the line/bar chart, changes in the three categories concerning 题目相关词 were divided between two upward movements and one downward movement.
翻译：折线/柱状图清晰展示，与题目相关词相关的三类数据变化呈现两类上涨、一类下降的趋势。
②As is vividly illustrated in the line/bar chart, changes in the three categories concerning 题目相关词 fall into three groups: upward movements, downward movements and stable levels. 出现不变数据时用
翻译：折线/柱状图清晰展示，与题目相关词相关的三类变化分为三种趋势：上升、下降、保持平稳。

真题范文改写变体

①As is vividly illustrated in the bar chart, changes in the two categories concerning China's urban and rural populations from 1990 to 2010 were divided between one upward movement and one downward movement. 2014城乡人口
翻译：柱状图清晰展现1990至2010年中国城乡人口两类数据一升一降。
②As is vividly illustrated in the bar chart, changes in the three categories concerning the market share of car brands in the domestic market fall into three groups: upward movements, downward movements and stable levels. 2011汽车品牌
翻译：柱状图中国内汽车品牌市场份额三类数据分为上涨、下跌、平稳三类走势。
③As is vividly illustrated in the bar chart, changes in the two categories concerning mobile-phone subscriptions were divided between two upward movements. 2010手机用户
翻译：柱状图里两类手机用户数据均呈上升趋势。
④As is vividly illustrated in the line chart, changes in the two categories concerning the number of museums and visitors in China from 2013 to 2015 were divided between two upward movements. 2017博物馆游客
翻译：折线图清晰展现2013至2015年中国博物馆数量和游客数量两类数据均呈上升趋势。
⑤As is vividly illustrated in the bar chart, changes in the three categories concerning choices among college graduates were divided between two upward movements and one downward movement. 2019毕业生去向
翻译：柱状图清晰展现了高校毕业生三类去向选择的数据变化，呈两升一降态势。
⑥As is vividly illustrated in the bar chart, changes in the two categories concerning Chinese express delivery volume from 2018 to 2020 were both on the rise. 2022农村快递
翻译：柱状图清晰展示2018至2020年中国快递业务量两类数据均呈上涨趋势。
⑦As is vividly illustrated in the line chart, the change in one category concerning the level of Chinese residents' health literacy showed a steady climbing trend. 2023健康素养
翻译：折线图清晰展示，中国居民健康素养水平这一类数据呈现稳步攀升趋势。

2. 数据变化描述句

（1）描述上升

①From 时间1 to 时间2, 事物1 rose from 数字1 to 数字2, showing a steady upward trend / a sharp increase.
翻译：从时间1到时间2，事物1数值从数字1增长至数字2，呈现稳步上升/大幅激增。
②From 2008 to 2009, Chinese brands jumped from 25% to 33%, showing a sharp increase. 2011 jump替换rose
翻译：2008到2009年，国产品牌占比从25%猛增至33%，涨幅显著。
③From 2018 to 2020, the number of express parcels in the countryside rose from 12 billion to 30 billion, showing a sharp increase. 2022农村快递
翻译：2018到2020年，农村快递量从120亿件增至300亿件，涨幅显著。
③From 1990 to 2010, the urban population rose from 300 million to 670 million, showing a sharp increase. 2014
翻译：1990至2010年，城镇人口从3亿增至6.7亿，大幅上涨。
④From 2000 to 2008, mobile-phone subscriptions in developing countries rose from less than 1 billion to 4 billion, showing a sharp increase. 2010
翻译：2000至2008年，发展中国家手机用户从不足10亿增长至40亿，大幅上升。
⑤Meanwhile, those in developed countries rose from 5 million to 1 billion, showing a steady upward trend. 2010两类上升区分
翻译：与此同时，发达国家手机用户从500万增长至10亿，稳步上涨。
⑥From 2013 to 2015, the number of museums rose from 4165 to 4692, showing a steady upward trend. 2017博物馆稳步上升
翻译：2013至2015年，博物馆数量从4165家增至4692家，稳步上升。
⑦Meanwhile, the number of visitors jumped from 637.8 million to 781.1 million, indicating a sharp increase. 2017游客大幅增长
翻译：与此同时，游客数量从6.378亿猛增至7.811亿，增幅显著。
新句式·两升合并：From 时间1 to 时间2, 事物1 rose from 数字1 to 数字2 and 事物2 rose from 数字3 to 数字4, both showing steady upward trends.
翻译：从时间1到时间2，事物1从数字1升至数字2，事物2从数字3升至数字4，两者均呈稳步上升趋势。
⑧From 2013 to 2018, the choice of further study rose from 26.3% to 34% and the choice of starting a business rose from 1.3% to 2.6%, both showing steady upward trends. 2019两升合并
翻译：2013至2018年，选择升学的比例从26.3%升至34%，选择创业的比例从1.3%升至2.6%，两者均呈稳步上升趋势。

（2）描述下降

①Meanwhile, 事物2 fell from 数字3 to 数字4, indicating a clear decline / a sharp decrease.
翻译：与此同时，事物2数值从数字3降至数字4，出现明显下滑/大幅减少。
②Over the same span, the rural population fell from 830 million to 670 million, indicating a sharp decrease. 2014 over the same span替换meanwhile
翻译：同一时期，农村人口从8.3亿降至6.7亿，大幅减少。
③Meanwhile, Japanese brands fell from 35% to 25%, indicating a sharp decrease. 2011
翻译：同时日系汽车品牌占比从35%下跌至25%，降幅明显。

（3）描述数据持平

By contrast, 事物3 remained stable at roughly 数字5 with little fluctuation.
翻译：与之相反，事物3数据稳定维持在数字5左右，波动极小。
例句：By contrast, American brands remained stable at roughly 15% with little fluctuation. 2011
翻译：反观美系品牌占比稳定在15%上下，几乎无波动。

3. 原因分析段成套句式

句1：引出社会现象

基础模板：The public's demand for 题目相关词 is by no means a recent phenomenon; it has become increasingly evident today because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now more fully in place.
翻译：大众对题目相关词的需求并非新近出现的现象，如今该趋势愈发明显，满足该需求的各类条件已日趋完善。
①The public's desire for urban life is by no means a recent phenomenon; it has become increasingly evident today because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now more fully in place. 2014 desire替换demand
翻译：民众对城市生活的向往并非近期才出现，如今愈发突出，实现定居城市的各类条件已更加完善。
②The public's demand for express delivery services is by no means a recent phenomenon; it has become increasingly evident today because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now fully in place. 2022农村快递
翻译：民众对快递服务的需求并非新鲜趋势，如今愈发明显，享受快递服务的条件已十分完备。
②The public's demand for Chinese car brands is by no means a recent phenomenon; it has become increasingly evident today because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now more fully in place. 2011
翻译：民众青睐国产汽车并非新鲜趋势，如今愈发明显，选购国产车的客观条件已十分完备。
③The public's demand for mobile-phone subscriptions is by no means a recent phenomenon; it has become increasingly evident today because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now more fully in place. 2010
翻译：大众对手机使用的需求早已存在，如今普及趋势愈发显著，使用手机的配套条件已全面完善。

句2：经济/客观基础句

基础模板：Rapid national economic growth has laid a solid material foundation for 题目相关词 to become integrated into everyday life and gain widespread popularity.
翻译：国家经济快速发展，为题目相关词融入日常生活、广泛普及打下坚实物质基础。
①The rapid growth of the Chinese economy has laid a solid material foundation for the rural population to become integrated into urban life and gain widespread popularity. 2014
翻译：中国经济飞速发展，为农村人口融入城市生活奠定坚实物质基础。
②Rapid growth of the Chinese economy has laid a solid material foundation for Chinese car brands to become integrated into everyday life and gain widespread popularity. 2011
翻译：中国经济高速发展，助力国产汽车走进千家万户、普及开来。
③Rapid economic growth in developing countries has laid a solid material foundation for mobile-phone subscriptions to become integrated into everyday life and gain widespread popularity. 2010
翻译：发展中国家经济快速增长，为手机普及奠定物质基础。
新句式·社会基础：Growing social emphasis on 知识/能力等 has laid a solid social foundation for 题目相关词 to become integrated into 某群体' options and gain widespread popularity.
翻译：社会对……的日益重视，为题目相关词融入某群体的选择并广泛普及奠定了坚实的社会基础。
④Growing social emphasis on knowledge and competence has laid a solid social foundation for further study to become integrated into college students' options and gain widespread popularity. 2019社会基础
翻译：社会对知识和能力的日益重视，为升学融入大学生的选择并广泛普及奠定了坚实的社会基础。

句3：社会发展+民众观念转变句

基础模板：Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and individuals become more financially secure, public attitudes evolve accordingly, making people more receptive to 题目相关词.
翻译：与此同时，随着社会持续发展、居民经济条件宽裕，大众观念随之转变，更愿意接纳题目相关词。
①Meanwhile, as urban infrastructure continues to improve and individuals become more financially secure, public attitudes evolve accordingly, making people more receptive to urban living. 2014新增城市基建
翻译：同时城市基础设施持续完善、居民收入提升，民众更向往城市生活。
②Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and individuals become more financially secure, consumers tend to choose cost-effective domestic cars with higher performance at lower prices, making people more receptive to Chinese car brands. 2011补充产品优势
翻译：社会进步、收入提高后，消费者偏爱性价比高、质优价廉的国产车，更认可国产品牌。
③Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and individuals become more financially secure, public attitudes evolve accordingly, making people more receptive to mobile-phone subscriptions. 2010原版套用
翻译：社会不断发展、居民经济宽裕，大众观念改变，普遍接受手机。
新句式·个人能力：Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and individuals' learning ability grows, 某群体' attitudes have evolved accordingly, making 某群体 more receptive to 题目相关词.
翻译：同时，随着社会不断进步和个人学习能力的提升，某群体的态度相应转变，使他们更乐于接受题目相关词。
Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and individuals' learning ability grows, college students' attitudes have evolved accordingly, making college students more receptive to the choice of further study. 2019个人能力
翻译：同时，随着社会不断进步和个人学习能力的提升，大学生的态度相应转变，使他们更乐于选择升学。

句4：双重归因总结句

基础模板：It is therefore evident that the growing prevalence of 题目相关词 owes as much to rising public demand as it does to the practical support that society provides for individual choice.
翻译：由此显而易见，题目相关词日渐普及，既源于民众日益增长的需求，也离不开社会为个人选择提供的配套支撑。
①It is therefore evident that the growing prevalence of urban living owes as much to rising public demand as it does to the practical support that society provides for individual choice. 2014
翻译：可见城市生活普及，一方面源于民众向往，另一方面得益于社会配套保障。
②It is therefore evident that the growing prevalence of Chinese car brands owes as much to the booming Chinese economy as it does to the practical advantage of domestic cars' high performance at lower prices. 2011替换后半段原因
翻译：国产汽车走红，既得益于蓬勃发展的国内经济，也归功于国产车物美价廉的优势。

句5：通用原因分析句式（适用于各类话题）

基础模板句1：The deeper value of 题目相关词 lies in enabling individuals to develop a genuine capacity for choice.
翻译：题目相关词更深层的价值在于使个体发展出真正的选择能力。
基础模板句2：Confronted with a multitude of possibilities, those who possess 题目相关词 do not allow external voices to dictate their decisions; rather, they can discern what deserves their commitment and are prepared to bear the costs their choices entail.
翻译：面对众多可能性，拥有题目相关词的人不会让外界声音左右自己的决定；相反，他们能辨别什么值得投入，并准备好承担选择带来的代价。
基础模板句3：Moreover, as 题目相关词 takes deeper root, individuals become more adept at navigating difficulties with composure and flexibility.
翻译：此外，随着题目相关词深入人心，个体变得更善于以从容和灵活的态度应对困难。
基础模板句4：Thus, the most important transformation brought about by 题目相关词 is that it enables individuals to progress from merely having options to possessing the judgment and resolve required to choose wisely.
翻译：因此，题目相关词带来的最重要转变是，它使个体从仅仅拥有选择，进步到拥有明智选择所需的判断力和决心。
①The deeper value of students' part-time jobs lies in enabling individuals to develop a genuine capacity for choice. 2013
翻译：学生兼职更深层的价值在于使个体发展出真正的选择能力。
②Confronted with a multitude of possibilities, those who possess part-time work experience do not allow external voices to dictate their decisions; rather, they discern what deserves their commitment and are prepared to bear the costs their choices entail. 2013
翻译：面对众多可能性，有兼职经历的人不会让外界声音左右自己的决定；相反，他们能辨别什么值得投入，并准备好承担选择带来的代价。
③Meanwhile, a rich spare-time life provides favorable conditions for students' part-time jobs to become integrated into university life and gain widespread popularity. 2013
翻译：同时，丰富的课余生活为学生兼职融入大学生活并广泛普及提供了有利条件。

4. 结尾总结与升华句式

句1：发展总起句

基础模板：Sustaining the development of 题目相关词 depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results.
翻译：推动题目相关词持续发展，不只依靠扶持力度，更关键在于相关扶持能否产生实实在在的成效。
①Sustaining the growth of the urban population depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results. 2014 growth替换development
翻译：促进城镇人口持续增长，关键在于配套政策能否落地见效。
②Sustaining the development of express delivery services depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results. 2022农村快递
翻译：推动快递业持续发展，不能只看扶持力度，更要看政策能否带来实际成效。
②Sustaining the development of Chinese car brands depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results. 2011
翻译：推动国产汽车持续发展，不能只看扶持力度，更要看政策能否带来实际效果。
③Sustaining the development of mobile-phone subscriptions depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results. 2010
翻译：手机普及的持续推进，重点在于配套举措能否产生实际成效。

句2：政府对策句

基础模板：Relevant authorities should both create the necessary conditions and adjust specific measures promptly in light of how 题目相关词 develops in practice.
翻译：有关部门既要完善配套条件，也要结合题目相关词发展现状及时调整政策。
2014范文：Relevant authorities should both create the necessary conditions and adjust specific measures promptly in light of how the urban population grows in practice.
翻译：有关部门既要完善配套条件，也要结合城镇人口发展现状及时调整政策。

句3：个人角度对策句

基础模板：Individuals, for their part, should carefully assess the value of 题目相关词 in accordance with their own circumstances.
翻译：个人方面则应根据自身情况，认真评估题目相关词的价值。

句4：倒装升华结尾句

基础模板：Only through effective interaction among all parties can 题目相关词 become genuinely integrated into social life.
翻译：只有多方协同配合、良性互动，题目相关词才能真正融入社会生活。
2014范文：Only through effective interaction among all parties can the rural population become genuinely integrated into urban life.
翻译：只有多方协同配合、良性互动，农村人口才能真正融入城市生活。
2022范文：Only through effective interaction among all parties can express delivery services become genuinely integrated into social life.
翻译：只有各方有效互动，快递服务才能真正融入社会生活。

5. 动态图专属替换词&加分表达

英文短语中文释义出处
jump from…to…（数据）大幅飙升2011汽车范文
over the same span同一时期内（替换meanwhile）2014城乡人口
desire for sth.对……的向往（替换demand）2014
urban infrastructure城市基础设施2014
cost-effective / higher performance at lower prices性价比高、物美价廉2011汽车
booming Chinese economy蓬勃发展的中国经济2011
sustain the growth of…推动……持续增长2014
effective interaction among all parties多方协同配合2014

MODULE 02 · STATIC

静态图表写作全套句式

适用：饼图、静态柱状图（占比/排名对比）。数据不随时间变化，重在对比与归因。

二、静态图表写作全套句式

适用：饼图、静态柱状图（数据占比对比，无时间变化）

1. 开篇数据段（开篇+占比描写合并）

通用基础模板

数据不相等 The bar/pie chart presents five categories concerning 题目相关词 and reveals a pronounced ranking pattern. With a share of 百分比1, 事物1 ranks well ahead of all the others. 事物2 accounts for 百分比2, while 事物3 takes up 百分比3. At the other end of the scale, 事物4 and 事物5 account for the smallest proportions, at only 百分比4 and 百分比5.
翻译：柱状/饼图展示了与题目相关词相关的五个类别，呈现出鲜明的排名规律。事物1占比百分比1，遥遥领先。事物2占比百分比2，事物3占比百分比3。在占比最低端，事物4和事物5占比最小，仅为百分比4和百分比5。
数据相等 The bar/pie chart presents five categories concerning 题目相关词 and reveals a pronounced ranking pattern. With a share of 百分比1, 事物1 ranks well ahead of all the others. 事物2 and 事物3 each account for 相同百分比. At the other end of the scale, 事物4 and 事物5 account for the smallest proportions, at only 百分比4 and 百分比5.
翻译：柱状/饼图展示了与题目相关词相关的五个类别，呈现出鲜明的排名规律。事物1占比百分比1，遥遥领先。事物2和事物3各占相同百分比。在占比最低端，事物4和事物5占比最小，仅为百分比4和百分比5。

范文改写变体

2026范文：The bar chart presents four categories concerning the survey on children's outdoor activities and reveals a pronounced ranking pattern. With a share of 54.6%, satisfying their curiosity ranks well ahead of all the others. Enhancing their powers of observation, building up their bodies and strengthening parent-child interaction, account for 54.5%, 37.2% and 33.2% respectively.
翻译：柱状图展示了关于儿童户外活动调查的四个类别，呈现出鲜明的排名规律。满足好奇心占比54.6%，遥遥领先。提升观察力、强身健体和增进亲子互动分别占比54.5%、37.2%和33.2%。
2015范文：The pie chart presents four categories concerning the proportions of residents' consumption in a Chinese city during the Spring Festival and reveals a pronounced ranking pattern. With a share of 40%, New-Year gifts rank well ahead of all the others. Parties, transportation and other expenses each account for 20%.
翻译：饼图展示了中国某城市居民春节期间消费比例的四个类别，呈现出鲜明的排名规律。新年礼物占比40%，遥遥领先。聚会、交通和其他支出各占20%。
2013范文：The comparison of the four categories related to university students' part-time job participation in the bar chart reveals a pronounced ranking pattern. With a share of 88.24%, seniors rank well ahead of all the others. Sophomores and juniors occupy the two middle positions, registering 71.13% and 71.93% respectively. For freshmen, the proportion is only 67.77%.
翻译：柱状图对比了大学生兼职参与度的四个类别，呈现出鲜明的排名规律。大四学生占比88.24%，遥遥领先。大二和大三学生处于中间梯队，占比分别为71.13%和71.93%。大一学生的占比仅为67.77%。
③The pie chart presents five categories concerning university students' travelling purposes surveyed and reveals a pronounced ranking pattern. With a share of 37%, enjoying scenery ranks well ahead of all the others. 2016大学生旅游
翻译：饼图展示大学生旅游目的的五类调查结果，赏景以37%占比遥遥领先。
2024范文：The bar chart presents four categories concerning the survey of students' main gains from labor practice courses in a university and reveals a pronounced ranking pattern. With a share of 91.3%, learning relevant knowledge ranks well ahead of all the others. 2024劳动实践
翻译：柱状图展示某高校学生劳动实践课主要收获的四类调查结果，学习相关知识以91.3%占比遥遥领先。
2025范文：The bar chart presents five categories concerning the survey of main daily leisure activities of the elderly in a community and reveals a pronounced ranking pattern. With a share of 90.8%, watching TV ranks well ahead of all the others. 2025老年休闲
翻译：柱状图展示某社区老年人日常主要休闲活动的五类调查结果，看电视以90.8%占比遥遥领先。

2. 原因分析段成套句式

句1：引出社会现象

基础模板：The public's demand for 题目相关词 is by no means a recent phenomenon; it occupies a notable position in daily life because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now more fully in place.
翻译：大众对题目相关词的需求并非新近出现的现象；它在日常生活中占有显著地位，因为满足该需求的各类条件如今已更加完善。
2015范文：The public's demand for New-year gifts is by no means a recent phenomenon; it occupies a prominent position in Spring-Festival spending, because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now more fully in place.
翻译：大众对新年礼物的需求并非新近出现的现象；它在春节消费中占有突出地位，因为满足该需求的各类条件如今已更加完善。
2026范文：Parents' demand for children's outdoor activities is by no means a recent phenomenon; it has become increasingly evident today because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now more fully in place.
翻译：家长对孩子户外活动的需求并非新近出现的现象，如今该趋势愈发明显，因为满足该需求的各类条件已更加完善。

句2：经济/客观基础句

基础模板：Rapid national economic growth has laid a solid material foundation for 题目相关词 to become integrated into everyday life and enjoy great popularity.
翻译：国家经济快速发展，为题目相关词融入日常生活并广受欢迎奠定了坚实的物质基础。
2015范文：Rapid national economic growth has laid a solid material foundation for New-year gifts to become integrated into the Spring Festival and enjoy great popularity.
翻译：国家经济快速发展，为新年礼物融入春节并广受欢迎奠定了坚实的物质基础。
2026范文：Parents' focus on children's growth has laid a solid material foundation for outdoor activities to become integrated into everyday life and gain widespread popularity.
翻译：家长对孩子成长的关注，为户外活动融入日常生活并广泛普及奠定了坚实的基础。

句3：社会发展+民众观念转变句

基础模板：Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and individuals become more financially secure, public attitudes evolve accordingly, making people more receptive to 题目相关词.
翻译：与此同时，随着社会持续发展、居民经济条件宽裕，大众观念随之转变，更愿意接纳题目相关词。
2015范文：Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and individuals become more financially secure, public attitudes evolve accordingly, making people more receptive to New-year gifts.
翻译：与此同时，随着社会持续发展、居民经济条件宽裕，大众观念随之转变，更愿意购买新年礼物。
2026范文：Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and individuals become more financially secure, parental attitudes evolve accordingly, making parents more receptive to children's outdoor activities.
翻译：与此同时，随着社会持续发展、居民经济条件宽裕，家长观念随之转变，更重视孩子的户外活动。

句4：双重归因总结句

基础模板：It is therefore evident that the current popularity of 题目相关词 owes as much to sustained public demand as it does to the practical support that society provides for individual choice.
翻译：因此显而易见，题目相关词如今的流行，既源于公众持续的需求，也得益于社会为个人选择提供的实际支持。
2015范文：It is therefore evident that the current popularity of New-year gifts owes as much to sustained public demand as it does to the practical support society provides for individual choice.
翻译：因此显而易见，新年礼物如今的流行，既源于公众持续的需求，也得益于社会为个人选择提供的实际支持。
2026范文：It is therefore evident that the growing prevalence of children's outdoor activities owes as much to children's rising demand as it does to the practical support that parents provide for children's choices.
翻译：因此显而易见，儿童户外活动日益普及，既源于孩子不断增长的需求，也得益于家长为孩子选择提供的实际支持。

校园类特殊句式（2013用）

2013范文（校园类）：The deeper value of students' part-time jobs lies in enabling individuals to develop a genuine capacity for choice. Confronted with a multitude of possibilities, those who possess part-time work experience do not allow external voices to dictate their decisions; rather, they discern what deserves their commitment and are prepared to bear the costs their choices entail. Meanwhile, a rich spare-time life provides favorable conditions for students' part-time jobs to become integrated into university life and gain widespread popularity.
翻译：大学生兼职的深层价值在于培养个体真正的选择能力。面对众多可能性，有兼职经历的学生不会让外界声音左右自己的决定，而是辨别什么值得投入，并准备承担选择带来的代价。同时，丰富的课余生活为大学生兼职融入校园生活并广泛流行提供了有利条件。

3. 结尾升华段成套句式

句1：发展总起句

基础模板：Reasonable treatment of 题目相关词 depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results.
翻译：合理对待题目相关词，不仅取决于提供了多少支持，更重要的是这种支持是否产生了切实的成效。
2015范文：Reasonable treatment of this consumption pattern depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results.
翻译：合理对待这种消费模式，不仅取决于提供了多少支持，更重要的是这种支持是否产生了切实的成效。
2026范文：Sustaining the development of children's outdoor activities depends not merely on how much parental support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results for children.
翻译：持续发展儿童户外活动，不仅取决于家长提供了多少支持，更重要的是这种支持是否为孩子带来了切实的成效。
2013范文：Sustaining the development of students' part-time jobs depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results.
翻译：持续发展大学生兼职，不仅取决于提供了多少支持，更重要的是这种支持是否产生了切实的成效。

句2：政府/机构对策句

基础模板：Relevant authorities should both create the necessary conditions and adjust specific measures promptly in light of how 题目相关词 develops in practice.
翻译：相关部门应既创造必要条件，又根据题目相关词在实践中的发展情况及时调整具体措施。
2015范文：Relevant authorities should both create the necessary conditions and adjust specific measures promptly in light of how this consumption pattern develops in practice.
翻译：相关部门应既创造必要条件，又根据这种消费模式在实践中的发展情况及时调整具体措施。
2026范文：Parents should both create the necessary conditions and adjust specific measures promptly in light of how children develop in practice.
翻译：家长应既创造必要条件，又根据孩子在实践中的发展情况及时调整具体措施。
2013范文：Universities should both create the necessary conditions and adjust specific measures promptly in light of how students' part-time jobs develop in practice.
翻译：大学应既创造必要条件，又根据学生兼职在实践中的发展情况及时调整具体措施。

句3：个人对策句

基础模板：Individuals, for their part, should carefully assess the value of 题目相关词 in accordance with their own circumstances.
翻译：就个人而言，应根据自身情况认真评估题目相关词的价值。
2015范文：Individuals, for their part, should carefully assess the value of this consumption pattern in accordance with their own circumstances.
翻译：就个人而言，应根据自身情况认真评估这种消费模式的价值。
2013范文：Students, for their part, should carefully assess the value of part-time jobs in accordance with their own circumstances.
翻译：就学生而言，应根据自身情况认真评估兼职的价值。

句4：倒装升华结尾

基础模板：Only through effective interaction among all parties can 题目相关词 become genuinely integrated into social life.
翻译：只有通过各方的有效互动，题目相关词才能真正融入社会生活。
2015范文：Only through effective interaction among all parties can this consumption pattern become genuinely integrated into social life.
翻译：只有通过各方的有效互动，这种消费模式才能真正融入社会生活。
2026范文：Only through effective interaction among all parties can children's outdoor activities become genuinely integrated into everyday life.
翻译：只有通过各方的有效互动，儿童户外活动才能真正融入日常生活。

完整范文模块

以下为套用模板写出的完整范文，加粗部分为填入模板的具体内容，每篇附全文翻译。

完整范文模块

以下为套用模板写出的完整范文，加粗部分为填入模板的具体内容，每篇附全文翻译。

范文1：2010年英语二大作文（手机用户发展）

As is vividly illustrated in the bar chart, changes in the two categories concerning mobile-phone subscriptions were divided between two upward movements. From 2000 to 2008, mobile-phone subscriptions in developing countries rose from less than 1 billion to 4 billion, showing a sharp increase. Meanwhile, those in developed countries rose from 5 million to 1 billion, showing a steady upward trend.
The public's demand for mobile-phone subscriptions is by no means a recent phenomenon; it has become increasingly evident today because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now more fully in place. Rapid economic growth in developing countries has laid a solid material foundation for mobile-phone subscriptions to become integrated into everyday life and gain widespread popularity. Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and individuals become more financially secure, public attitudes evolve accordingly, making people more receptive to mobile-phone subscriptions.
Sustaining the development of mobile-phone subscriptions depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results.
全文翻译：柱状图里两类手机用户数据均呈上升趋势。2000至2008年，发展中国家手机用户从不足10亿增长至40亿，大幅上升。与此同时，发达国家手机用户从500万增长至10亿，稳步上涨。大众对手机使用的需求早已存在，如今普及趋势愈发显著，使用手机的配套条件已全面完善。发展中国家经济快速增长，为手机普及奠定物质基础。社会不断发展、居民经济宽裕，大众观念改变，普遍接受手机。手机普及的持续推进，重点在于配套举措能否产生实际成效。

范文2：2011年英语二大作文（汽车品牌市场份额）

As is vividly illustrated in the bar chart, changes in the three categories concerning the market share of car brands in the domestic market fall into three groups: upward movements, downward movements and stable levels. From 2008 to 2009, Chinese brands jumped from 25% to 33%, showing a sharp increase. Meanwhile, Japanese brands fell from 35% to 25%, indicating a sharp decrease. By contrast, American brands remained stable at roughly 15% with little fluctuation.
The public's demand for Chinese car brands is by no means a recent phenomenon; it has become increasingly evident today because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now more fully in place. Rapid growth of the Chinese economy has laid a solid material foundation for Chinese car brands to become integrated into everyday life and gain widespread popularity. Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and individuals become more financially secure, consumers tend to choose cost-effective domestic cars with higher performance at lower prices, making people more receptive to Chinese car brands. It is therefore evident that the growing prevalence of Chinese car brands owes as much to the booming Chinese economy as it does to the practical advantage of domestic cars' high performance at lower prices.
Sustaining the development of Chinese car brands depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results.
全文翻译：柱状图中国内汽车品牌市场份额三类数据分为上涨、下跌、平稳三类走势。2008到2009年，国产品牌占比从25%猛增至33%，涨幅显著。同时日系品牌占比从35%下跌至25%，降幅明显。反观美系品牌占比稳定在15%上下，几乎无波动。民众青睐国产汽车并非新鲜趋势，如今愈发明显，选购国产车的客观条件已十分完备。中国经济高速发展，助力国产汽车走进千家万户、普及开来。社会进步、收入提高后，消费者偏爱性价比高、质优价廉的国产车，更认可国产品牌。由此可见，国产汽车走红，既得益于蓬勃发展的国内经济，也归功于国产车物美价廉的优势。推动国产汽车持续发展，不能只看扶持力度，更要看政策能否带来实际效果。

范文3：2013年英语二大作文（大学生兼职）

The comparison of the four categories related to university students' part-time job participation in the bar chart reveals a pronounced ranking pattern. With a share of 88.24%, seniors rank well ahead of all the others. Sophomores and juniors occupy the two middle positions, registering 71.13% and 71.93% respectively. For freshmen, the proportion is only 67.77%.
The deeper value of students' part-time jobs lies in enabling individuals to develop a genuine capacity for choice. Confronted with a multitude of possibilities, those who possess part-time work experience do not allow external voices to dictate their decisions; rather, they discern what deserves their commitment and are prepared to bear the costs their choices entail. Meanwhile, a rich spare-time life provides favorable conditions for students' part-time jobs to become integrated into university life and gain widespread popularity.
Sustaining the development of students' part-time jobs depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results. Universities should both create the necessary conditions and adjust specific measures promptly in light of how students' part-time jobs develop in practice. Students, for their part, should carefully assess the value of part-time jobs in accordance with their own circumstances.
全文翻译：柱状图展示大学生兼职参与比例的四类对比，数据呈现鲜明的层级规律。大四学生占比88.24%，远超其他年级。大二和大三居中，分别为71.13%和71.93%。大一学生仅占67.77%。学生兼职的深层价值在于培养真正的选择能力。面对众多可能性，有兼职经历的学生不会让外界声音左右自己的决定，而是能辨别什么值得投入，并准备承担选择的代价。同时，丰富的课余生活为学生兼职融入大学生活、广泛普及提供了有利条件。推动学生兼职持续发展，不仅要看支持力度，更要看支持是否带来实际效果。高校应创造必要条件，并根据学生兼职的实际发展情况及时调整具体措施。学生自身也应根据个人情况认真评估兼职的价值。

范文4：2014年大作文（城乡人口变化）

As is vividly illustrated in the bar chart, changes in the two categories concerning China's urban and rural populations from 1990 to 2010 were divided between one upward movement and one downward movement. From 1990 to 2010, the urban population rose from 300 million to 670 million, showing a sharp increase. Over the same span, the rural population fell from 830 million to 670 million, indicating a sharp decrease.
The public's desire for urban life is by no means a recent phenomenon; it has become increasingly evident today because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now more fully in place. The rapid growth of the Chinese economy has laid a solid material foundation for the rural population to become integrated into urban life and gain widespread popularity. Meanwhile, as urban infrastructure continues to improve and individuals become more financially secure, public attitudes evolve accordingly, making people more receptive to urban living. It is therefore evident that the growing prevalence of urban living owes as much to rising public demand as it does to the practical support that society provides for individual choice.
Sustaining the growth of the urban population depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results. Relevant authorities should both create the necessary conditions and adjust specific measures promptly in light of how the urban population grows in practice. Only through effective interaction among all parties can the rural population become genuinely integrated into urban life.
全文翻译：柱状图清晰展现了1990至2010年中国城乡人口两类数据一升一降的变化。1990至2010年，城镇人口从3亿增至6.7亿，大幅上涨。同一时期，农村人口从8.3亿降至6.7亿，大幅减少。民众对城市生活的向往并非近期才出现，如今愈发突出，实现定居城市的各类条件已更加完善。中国经济飞速发展，为农村人口融入城市生活奠定了坚实物质基础。同时，城市基础设施持续完善、居民收入提升，民众观念随之转变，更向往城市生活。由此可见，城市生活日渐普及，一方面源于民众向往，另一方面得益于社会配套保障。促进城镇人口持续增长，关键在于配套政策能否落地见效。有关部门既要完善配套条件，也要结合城镇人口发展现状及时调整政策。只有多方协同配合、良性互动，农村人口才能真正融入城市生活。

范文5：2015年英语二大作文（春节消费比例）

The pie chart presents four categories concerning the proportions of residents' consumption in a Chinese city during the Spring Festival and reveals a pronounced ranking pattern. With a share of 40%, New-Year gifts rank well ahead of all the others. Parties, transportation and other expenses each account for 20%.
The public's demand for New-year gifts is by no means a recent phenomenon; it occupies a prominent position in Spring-Festival spending, because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now more fully in place. Rapid national economic growth has laid a solid material foundation for New-year gifts to become integrated into the Spring Festival and enjoy great popularity. Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and individuals become more financially secure, public attitudes evolve accordingly, making people more receptive to New-year gifts. It is therefore evident that the current popularity of New-year gifts owes as much to sustained public demand as it does to the practical support society provides for individual choice.
Reasonable treatment of this consumption pattern depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results. Relevant authorities should both create the necessary conditions and adjust specific measures promptly in light of how this consumption pattern develops in practice. Individuals, for their part, should carefully assess the value of this consumption pattern in accordance with their own circumstances. Only through effective interaction among all parties can this consumption pattern become genuinely integrated into social life.
全文翻译：饼图展示了中国某城市居民春节期间消费比例的四个类别，呈现出鲜明的排名规律。新年礼物占比40%，遥遥领先。聚会、交通和其他支出各占20%。大众对新年礼物的需求并非新近出现的现象；它在春节消费中占有突出地位，因为满足该需求的各类条件如今已更加完善。国家经济快速发展，为新年礼物融入春节并广受欢迎奠定了坚实的物质基础。与此同时，随着社会持续发展、居民经济条件宽裕，大众观念随之转变，更愿意购买新年礼物。因此显而易见，新年礼物如今的流行，既源于公众持续的需求，也得益于社会为个人选择提供的实际支持。合理对待这种消费模式，不仅取决于提供了多少支持，更重要的是这种支持是否产生了切实的成效。相关部门应既创造必要条件，又根据这种消费模式在实践中的发展情况及时调整具体措施。就个人而言，应根据自身情况认真评估这种消费模式的价值。只有通过各方的有效互动，这种消费模式才能真正融入社会生活。

范文X：2016年大作文（大学生旅游目的）

The pie chart presents five categories concerning university students' travelling purposes surveyed and reveals a pronounced ranking pattern. With a share of 37%, enjoying scenery ranks well ahead of all the others. Relieving pressure accounts for 33%, while other purposes take up 15%. At the other end of the scale, making new friends and cultivating independence account for the smallest proportions, at only 9% and 6%.
College students' demand for travelling is by no means a recent phenomenon; it occupies a prominent position in their spare-time life because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now more fully in place. Rapid development of the tourism industry has laid a solid material foundation for travelling to become integrated into college students' spare-time life and enjoy great popularity. Meanwhile, as college students enjoy more abundant spare time and they become more financially secure, their attitudes evolve accordingly, making students more receptive to travelling. It is therefore evident that the current popularity of travelling owes as much to sustained demand from college students as it does to the practical support that universities provide for students' choice.
Reasonable treatment of travelling depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results. Relevant authorities should both create the necessary conditions and adjust specific measures promptly in light of how travelling develops in practice. College students, for their part, should carefully assess the value of travelling in accordance with their own circumstances. Only through effective interaction among all parties can travelling become genuinely integrated into students' spare-time life.
全文翻译：饼图展示了大学生旅游目的的五类调查结果，呈现明显的排名格局。赏景以37%的占比遥遥领先，缓解压力占33%，其他目的占15%。另一端，交友和培养独立性占比最小，仅为9%和6%。大学生旅游并非新鲜现象，它在课余生活中占据重要位置，因为满足这一需求的条件已十分完备。旅游业的快速发展，为旅游融入大学生课余生活、广受欢迎奠定了物质基础。大学生课余时间更充裕、经济更有保障后，态度随之转变，更乐于旅游。由此可见，旅游如今的流行，既源于大学生持续增长的需求，也归功于学校为学生选择提供的实际支持。合理对待旅游，不能只看扶持力度，更要看政策能否带来实际成效。相关部门应创造必要条件，并根据旅游发展实际及时调整具体措施。大学生也应根据自身情况理性评估旅游的价值。只有各方有效互动，旅游才能真正融入学生课余生活。

范文7：2017年大作文（博物馆与游客数量）

As is vividly illustrated in the line chart, changes in the two categories concerning the number of museums and visitors in China from 2013 to 2015 were divided between two upward movements. From 2013 to 2015, the number of museums rose from 4165 to 4692, showing a steady upward trend. Meanwhile, the number of visitors jumped from 637.8 million to 781.1 million, indicating a sharp increase.
The public's demand for museum visits is by no means a recent phenomenon; it has become increasingly evident today because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are more fully in place. Rapid national economic growth has laid a solid material foundation for museum visits to become integrated into everyday life and gain widespread popularity. Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and individuals become more financially secure, public attitudes have evolved accordingly, making people more receptive to museum visits. It is therefore evident that the growing prevalence of museum visits owes as much to rising public demand as it does to the practical support that society provides for individual choice.
Sustaining the development of museums depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results. Relevant authorities should both create the necessary conditions and adjust specific measures promptly in light of how museums develop in practice. Only through effective interaction among all parties can museum culture become genuinely integrated into social life.
全文翻译：折线图清晰展现2013至2015年中国博物馆数量和游客数量两类数据均呈上升趋势。2013至2015年，博物馆数量从4165家增至4692家，稳步上升。与此同时，游客数量从6.378亿猛增至7.811亿，增幅显著。大众对博物馆参观的需求并非新近出现的现象，如今愈发明显，因为满足该需求的条件已更加完善。国民经济快速增长为博物馆参观融入日常生活并广泛普及奠定了坚实的物质基础。同时，随着社会不断进步和个人经济状况改善，公众态度相应转变，使人们更乐于参观博物馆。因此显而易见，博物馆参观的日益普及既归功于公众需求的增长，也归功于社会为个人选择提供的实际支持。博物馆的持续发展不仅取决于提供多少支持，更重要的是这些支持能否产生切实成果。相关部门应创造必要条件，并根据博物馆实践发展及时调整具体措施。只有通过各方有效互动，博物馆文化才能真正融入社会生活。

范文8：2019年大作文（高校毕业生去向）

As is vividly illustrated in the bar chart, changes in the three categories concerning choices among college graduates were divided between two upward movements and one downward movement. From 2013 to 2018, the choice of further study rose from 26.3% to 34% and the choice of starting a business rose from 1.3% to 2.6%, both showing steady upward trends. Meanwhile, the choice of employment fell from 68.1% to 60.7%, indicating a clear decline.
The college students' demand for the choice of further study is by no means a recent phenomenon; it has become increasingly evident today because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now more fully in place. Growing social emphasis on knowledge and competence has laid a solid social foundation for further study to become integrated into college students' options and gain widespread popularity. Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and individuals' learning ability grows, college students' attitudes have evolved accordingly, making college students more receptive to the choice of further study.
Sustaining the development of further study depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results. Universities should both create the necessary conditions and adjust specific measures promptly in light of how further study develops in practice. College students, for their part, should carefully assess the value of the choice of further study in accordance with their own circumstances.
全文翻译：柱状图清晰展现了高校毕业生三类去向选择的数据变化，呈两升一降态势。2013至2018年，选择升学的比例从26.3%升至34%，选择创业的比例从1.3%升至2.6%，两者均呈稳步上升趋势。与此同时，选择就业的比例从68.1%降至60.7%，出现明显下滑。大学生对升学选择的需求并非新近出现的现象，如今愈发明显，因为满足该需求的条件已更加完善。社会对知识和能力的日益重视为升学融入大学生的选择并广泛普及奠定了坚实的社会基础。同时，随着社会不断进步和个人学习能力的提升，大学生的态度相应转变，使他们更乐于选择升学。升学的持续发展不仅取决于提供多少支持，更重要的是这些支持能否产生切实成果。高校应创造必要条件，并根据升学实践发展及时调整具体措施。大学生自身也应根据自身情况审慎评估升学选择的价值。

范文X：2022年大作文（农村快递发展）

As is vividly illustrated in the bar chart, changes in the two categories concerning Chinese express delivery volume from 2018 to 2020 were both on the rise. From 2018 to 2020, the number of express parcels in the countryside rose from 12 billion to 30 billion and the number of express parcels nationwide rose from 51 billion to 83 billion, both showing a sharp increase.
The public's demand for express delivery services is by no means a recent phenomenon; it has become increasingly evident today because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now fully in place. Rapid national economic growth has laid a solid material foundation for express delivery services to become integrated into everyday life and gain widespread popularity. Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and individuals become more financially secure, public attitudes evolve accordingly, making people more receptive to express delivery services. It is therefore evident that the growing prevalence of express delivery services owes as much to rising public demand as it does to the practical support that society provides for individual choice.
Sustaining the development of express delivery services depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results. Relevant authorities should both create the necessary conditions and adjust specific measures promptly in light of how express delivery services develop in practice. Only through effective interaction among all parties can express delivery services become genuinely integrated into social life.
全文翻译：柱状图清晰展示，2018至2020年中国快递业务量两类数据均呈上涨趋势。2018到2020年，农村快递量从120亿件增至300亿件，全国快递量从510亿件增至830亿件，涨幅显著。民众对快递服务的需求并非新鲜趋势，如今愈发明显，享受快递服务的条件已十分完备。国家经济快速发展，为快递服务走进千家万户、普及开来奠定了物质基础。社会进步、个人收入提高后，公众态度随之转变，更乐于接受快递服务。由此可见，快递业的蓬勃发展，既得益于持续增长的公众需求，也归功于社会为个人选择提供的实际支持。推动快递业持续发展，不能只看扶持力度，更要看政策能否带来实际成效。有关部门既要创造必要条件，也要根据快递业发展实际及时调整具体措施。只有多方协同配合、良性互动，快递服务才能真正融入社会生活。

范文X：2023年英语二大作文（居民健康素养）

As is vividly illustrated in the line chart, the change in one category concerning the level of Chinese residents' health literacy showed a steady climbing trend. From 2012 to 2021, the percentage of health literacy rose from 8.8% to 25.4%, showing a clear upward trend.
The public's demand for enhanced health literacy is by no means a recent phenomenon; it has become increasingly evident today because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now more fully in place. Rapid advances in new media have laid a solid foundation for enhanced health literacy to become integrated into everyday life and gain widespread popularity. Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and individuals become more financially secure, public attitudes have evolved accordingly, making people more receptive to health knowledge. It is therefore evident that the growing prevalence of health knowledge owes as much to rising public demand as it does to the practical support that society provides for individual choice.
Sustaining the improvement of residents' health literacy depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results. Individuals, for their part, should carefully assess the value of health knowledge in accordance with their own circumstances.
全文翻译：折线图清晰展示，中国居民健康素养水平这一类数据呈现稳步攀升趋势。2012至2021年，健康素养比例从8.8%上升至25.4%，呈明显上升趋势。民众对提升健康素养的需求并非新鲜趋势，如今愈发明显，满足这一需求的条件已更加完备。新媒体的快速发展，为健康素养融入日常生活、广受欢迎奠定了坚实基础。社会进步、个人收入提高后，公众态度随之转变，更乐于接受健康知识。由此可见，健康知识的日益普及，既源于民众持续增长的需求，也归功于社会为个人选择提供的实际支持。持续提升居民健康素养，不能只看扶持力度，更要看政策能否带来实际成效。个人也应根据自身情况，理性评估健康知识的价值。

范文X：2024年英语二大作文（劳动实践课收获）

The bar chart presents four categories concerning the survey of students' main gains from labor practice courses in a university and reveals a pronounced ranking pattern. With a share of 91.3%, learning relevant knowledge ranks well ahead of all the others. Improving practical abilities accounts for 84.8%, while feeling relaxed and happy takes up 54.4%. At the other end of the scale, enhancing cooperative ability accounts for the smallest proportion, at only 32.6%.
The students' demand for labor practice courses is by no means a recent phenomenon; it occupies a notable position in campus education because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now more fully in place. Rapid social development has laid a solid material foundation for labor practice courses to become integrated into college life and enjoy great popularity. Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and young people attach more importance to all-round development, public attitudes evolve accordingly, making college students more receptive to labor practice courses. It is therefore evident that the current popularity of labor practice courses owes as much to sustained students' demand as it does to the practical support that universities and society provide for individual choice.
Reasonable treatment of labor practice courses depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results. Individuals, for their part, should carefully assess the value of labor practice courses in accordance with their own circumstances.
全文翻译：柱状图展示了某高校学生劳动实践课主要收获的四类调查结果，呈现明显的排名格局。学习相关知识以91.3%的占比遥遥领先，提高实践能力占84.8%，感到轻松愉快占54.4%。另一端，增强合作能力占比最小，仅为32.6%。学生对劳动实践课的需求并非新鲜现象，它在校园教育中占据重要位置，因为满足这一需求的条件已十分完备。社会快速发展，为劳动实践课融入大学生活、广受欢迎奠定了物质基础。社会进步、年轻人更重视全面发展后，态度随之转变，大学生更乐于接受劳动实践课。由此可见，劳动实践课如今的流行，既源于学生持续增长的需求，也归功于学校和社会为个人选择提供的实际支持。合理对待劳动实践课，不能只看扶持力度，更要看政策能否带来实际成效。个人也应根据自身情况，理性评估劳动实践课的价值。

范文X：2025年英语二大作文（老年人休闲活动）

The bar chart presents five categories concerning the survey of main daily leisure activities of the elderly in a community and reveals a pronounced ranking pattern. With a share of 90.8%, watching TV ranks well ahead of all the others. Taking walks accounts for 68.3%, while gardening and reading both take up 34.7% and 31.8%. At the other end of the scale, playing chess accounts for the smallest proportion, at only 18.4%.
The elderly's demand for diverse leisure activities is by no means a recent phenomenon; it occupies a prominent position in daily life because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now more fully in place. Rapid social progress has laid a solid material foundation for diverse leisure activities to become integrated into elderly people's everyday life and gain great popularity. Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and senior citizens enjoy more spare time, public attitudes evolve accordingly, making the elderly more receptive to these activities. It is therefore evident that the current popularity of leisure activities for the elderly owes as much to seniors' sustained demand as it does to the practical support society provides for individual choice.
Reasonable treatment of seniors' leisure life depends not merely on how much support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results. Seniors, for their part, should carefully assess the value of different pastimes in accordance with their own circumstances.
全文翻译：柱状图展示了某社区老年人日常主要休闲活动的五类调查结果，呈现明显的排名格局。看电视以90.8%的占比遥遥领先，散步占68.3%，养花和阅读分别占34.7%和31.8%。另一端，下棋占比最小，仅为18.4%。老年人对多样化休闲活动的需求并非新鲜现象，它在日常生活中占据重要位置，因为满足这一需求的条件已十分完备。社会快速进步，为多样化休闲活动融入老年人日常生活、广受欢迎奠定了物质基础。社会进步、老年人闲暇时间增多后，公众态度随之转变，老年人更乐于接受这些活动。由此可见，老年人休闲活动如今的流行，既源于老年人持续增长的需求，也归功于社会为个人选择提供的实际支持。合理对待老年人休闲生活，不能只看扶持力度，更要看政策能否带来实际成效。老年人也应根据自身情况，理性评估不同娱乐方式的价值。

范文13：2026年英语二大作文（儿童户外活动）

The bar chart presents four categories concerning the survey on children's outdoor activities and reveals a pronounced ranking pattern. With a share of 54.6%, satisfying their curiosity ranks well ahead of all the others. Enhancing their powers of observation, building up their bodies and strengthening parent-child interaction, account for 54.5%, 37.2% and 33.2% respectively.
Parents' demand for children's outdoor activities is by no means a recent phenomenon; it has become increasingly evident today because the conditions necessary for satisfying that demand are now more fully in place. Parents' focus on children's growth has laid a solid material foundation for outdoor activities to become integrated into everyday life and gain widespread popularity. Meanwhile, as society continues to advance and individuals become more financially secure, parental attitudes evolve accordingly, making parents more receptive to children's outdoor activities. It is therefore evident that the growing prevalence of children's outdoor activities owes as much to children's rising demand as it does to the practical support that parents provide for children's choices.
Sustaining the development of children's outdoor activities depends not merely on how much parental support is provided, but more importantly on whether such support produces tangible results for children. Parents should both create the necessary conditions and adjust specific measures promptly in light of how children develop in practice. Only through effective interaction among all parties can children's outdoor activities become genuinely integrated into everyday life.
全文翻译：柱状图展示一项关于儿童户外活动的四类调查，各类占比层次分明。满足好奇心占比54.6%，位居首位。提升观察力、强身健体、增进亲子互动占比分别为54.5%、37.2%、33.2%。家长重视孩子户外活动并非新鲜趋势，如今该趋势愈发明显，开展户外活动的各类条件已更加完善。家长对孩子成长的重视，为户外活动融入孩子日常生活、普及开来打下基础。社会不断发展、家庭经济条件变好，家长观念随之转变，更加支持孩子参与户外活动。由此可见儿童户外活动普及，一方面源于孩子自身需求，另一方面离不开家长对孩子选择的支持。持续推广儿童户外活动，不只依靠家长支持，更关键在于这份支持能否真正有益于孩子成长。家长应当为孩子创造有利条件，并结合孩子实际成长情况及时调整安排。只有家庭、社会多方协同配合，户外活动才能真正融入孩子的日常生活。

三、全文通用万能替换词汇

1. 描述数据变化

英文中文
rise / a steady upward trend上升、稳步上涨
jump / a sharp increase大幅激增
fall / a sharp decrease / a clear decline下降、大幅下滑
remain stable with little fluctuation保持平稳、波动极小

2. 占比专用词

英文中文
with a share of占比……
register（数值）达到、占比为
account for占据（比例）
rank well ahead of all the others排名第一、遥遥领先
occupy the middle positions处于中间梯队
the smallest proportions最低占比
the proportion is only…占比仅为……
respectively分别地
part-time job participation兼职参与度

3. 社会发展类高级词

英文中文
gain widespread popularity广泛普及
growing prevalence日益普及
lay a solid material foundation打下坚实物质基础
financially secure经济宽裕、收入稳定

tangible results切实成效、实际效果
owe A as much to B as it does to C既得益于B，也归功于C
develop a genuine capacity for choice培养真正的选择能力
external voices外界声音、他人意见
discern what deserves commitment辨别什么值得投入
bear the costs one's choices entail承担选择带来的代价
a rich spare-time life丰富的课余生活

4. 动作/政策类表达

英文中文
sustain the development/growth of推动……持续发展/增长
create the necessary conditions创造配套条件
adjust specific measures promptly及时调整具体举措
in light of … in practice结合……实际情况
effective interaction among all parties多方协同配合
become genuinely integrated into everyday life真正融入日常生活
assess the value of … carefully认真评估……的价值
in accordance with one's own circumstances根据自身情况
for their part就他们而言、另一方面
